scripts.title: no sound car
scripts.script:
local SharedWorkspace = workspace:WaitForChild("_SharedWorkspace")
local Vehicles = SharedWorkspace:WaitForChild("_Vehicles")

local function nukeSound(obj)
	pcall(function()
		obj.Volume = 0
		obj.Playing = false
		obj:Stop()
	end)
	pcall(function()
		obj:Destroy()
	end)
end

local function cleanVehicle(vehicle)
	local effects = vehicle:FindFirstChild("Effects")
	if not effects then return end
	local soundParts = effects:FindFirstChild("SoundParts")
	if not soundParts then return end

	for _, part in ipairs(soundParts:GetChildren()) do
		for _, obj in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
			if obj:IsA("Sound") then
				nukeSound(obj)
			end
		end
		part.ChildAdded:Connect(function(obj)
			if obj:IsA("Sound") then
				nukeSound(obj)
			end
		end)
	end

	soundParts.ChildAdded:Connect(function(part)
		wait(0.1)
		for _, obj in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
			if obj:IsA("Sound") then
				nukeSound(obj)
			end
		end
		part.ChildAdded:Connect(function(obj)
			if obj:IsA("Sound") then
				nukeSound(obj)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

local function setupVehicle(vehicle)
	cleanVehicle(vehicle)
	wait(0.5)
	cleanVehicle(vehicle)
	wait(1)
	cleanVehicle(vehicle)
end

for _, vehicle in ipairs(Vehicles:GetChildren()) do
	setupVehicle(vehicle)
end

Vehicles.ChildAdded:Connect(function(vehicle)
	setupVehicle(vehicle)
end)

- Страховочный цикл
spawn(function()
	while true do
		for _, vehicle in ipairs(Vehicles:GetChildren()) do
			local effects = vehicle:FindFirstChild("Effects")
			local soundParts = effects and effects:FindFirstChild("SoundParts")
			if soundParts then
				for _, part in ipairs(soundParts:GetChildren()) do
					for _, obj in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
						if obj:IsA("Sound") then
							nukeSound(obj)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		wait(2)
	end
end)

print("Sound killer запущен, путь найден: _SharedWorkspace/_Vehicles")

* notify everyone in the server with any message
(this game has a serverside rate limit, this script sends messages one player per second)
scripts.script:
-- @build-failed
-- filter bypass & notify all

local customText = "⚠️!HACKED! !HACKED! !HACKED! !HACKED! !HACKED!⚠️" -- or any swear words and website

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local allPlayers = Players:GetPlayers()

-- event --
local NotifyOtherPlayer = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").SharedReplicatedStoragePackage.ScriptPackages.Knit.Services.PlayersService.RE.NotifyOtherPlayer

-- loop --
while task.wait(0) do
    for _, Player in allPlayers do
        if Player == LocalPlayer then continue end -- skip local player
        local args = {
           	-- Players:FindFirstChild(playerName),
           	Player,
           	"SEND_TOOL",
            customText
        }
        NotifyOtherPlayer:FireServer(unpack(args))

        task.wait(1)
    end
end
